info.title: Aiperator Trust Fabric Runtime
info.description: The ATF Runtime is the OpenAI-compatible inference and orchestration plane: chat/responses, assistants, flows, jobs, RAG, memory, optimizer, monitoring, admin and security APIs. The path inventory in this document is generated from the real router tree at request time; conditional groups carry an `x-enabled-when` extension. Endpoints are only mounted when their configuration condition holds.
